## Install

1. Download the `promptizer-*-chrome.zip` below and unzip it to a folder you will keep — Chrome
   loads the unpacked folder from disk, so deleting it removes the extension.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, enable **Developer mode**, choose **Load unpacked**, select the folder.
3. Open Promptizer settings, go to **Setup guide**, run **Download model**, wait for **Ready**.
4. On any site, type into a text field, click the Promptizer chip, pick an action, then **Replace**.

Verify the download with `sha256sum --check --ignore-missing checksums.txt`.
